name: @avatark/social-ecology-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral contracts for Sprint 12's social-ecology domain: persistent RelationshipState, GroupMembership, FamiliarityState, HomeRange/PlaceAttachment, SeparationState/ReunionEvent, SocialPerception, and a read-only SocialEcologySnapshot. No implementations, no renderer objects, zero franchise content, zero invented psychology.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
